title: Freddie Keppard, Oliver and Armstrong compared
summary: He swaps places with Keppard in Cook's band and judges Keppard strong but below Armstrong and Oliver; Armstrong had better technique, Oliver better ideas.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
